name: Dornnuk
description: A green-scaled Kav warrior who takes combat stimulants and tears himself apart while trying to shed.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Farakatolar's squad flies out to investigate a drifted fragment of Kavaron possibly a memorial vault, passing the glowing ruin of their world.
timeline.quote: Here, in this incandescent catastrophe, is the reason for all her missions.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The walls turn opalescent and the squad finds doorways and a corridor, then encounters an oily humanoid that touches Takoluk.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Takoluk's skull is found smashed in with no visible attacker, and a voice vibrates in their heads.
timeline.quote: But his skull has been smashed in.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Dornnuk, driven by stimulants, tears off his armor and scales and runs off down the corridors.
timeline.quote: he screams and runs down the corridor, scraps of armor and skin flying.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.
